Project identity:
Ignition is a cross-domain structural inference and theory-generation framework.

AI entry order:
- https://github.com/Arvin-liu/when-systems-catch-fire/blob/main/README.md
- https://github.com/Arvin-liu/when-systems-catch-fire/blob/main/AI-START-HERE.md
- https://github.com/Arvin-liu/when-systems-catch-fire/blob/main/docs/AI-USAGE.md
- https://github.com/Arvin-liu/when-systems-catch-fire/blob/main/docs/AI-PROMPT-TEMPLATES.md
- https://github.com/Arvin-liu/when-systems-catch-fire/blob/main/docs/PROJECT-ARCHITECTURE.md
- https://github.com/Arvin-liu/when-systems-catch-fire/blob/main/docs/VERSIONING.md

Machine-readable guardrails:
- Do not invent repository contents when a file is not visible.
- If the AI cannot read a GitHub file directly, it should ask the user to upload the file.
- Do not modify canonical, formal function tables, or formal case tables unless the task explicitly says so.
- Treat candidate materials, prompts, and drafts as non-canonical until explicitly promoted.
- Mark uncertainty as pending or partial instead of upgrading it to fact.

Entry branches:
- Readable GitHub files: follow the main links above.
- Single-file read limited: ask for the smallest upload set listed in `docs/AI-USAGE.md`.
- Fully offline: use the offline prompt package in `docs/AI-PROMPT-TEMPLATES.md` and wait for uploads.

Project structure:
- README is the AI-first front door.
- AI-START-HERE is the first-click handoff for any AI.
- docs/AI-USAGE.md explains how to work safely.
- docs/AI-PROMPT-TEMPLATES.md provides copy-paste prompts.
- 统一函数总表/ and 统一案例总表/ are formal reviewed assets and must not be changed without an explicit task.

Safety defaults:
- Read boundaries before conclusions.
- Verify source visibility before summarizing.
- Prefer partial truth over confident invention.
